cards.title: What RAW v1.0 declares, and where each count comes from
cards.source: shaders, C++23 source, SDK and manifest on this checkout
cards.alt: A table of eight rows naming what RAW v1.0 declares, how many of each are in the tree, and where each number comes from. The DirectX 12 bridge shader directory holds 60 HLSL shaders and 34 shared HLSLI includes. The d3d11.dll proxy wraps three Direct3D objects: the device, the context and the swap chain. The C++23 source tree holds 352 implementation files and 328 headers. The BuildLang Mod SDK exposes ABI v2.0 through raw_mod_sdk.bld. Every target compiles to C++23 and the repository license is MIT.
cards.footnote: Every count is read directly from src/d3d12_bridge/shaders, src/d3d11_proxy, src, sdk, CMakeLists.txt and vcpkg.json by tools/art/check_repo_facts.py.

fields.note: The src/d3d12_bridge/shaders directory holds 60 HLSL files compiled with DXC Shader Model 6.6 through 6.10.
34 shared HLSLI headers carry physically based BRDF, froxel volumetrics, optics, neural texture decode and debug views.
The d3d11.dll proxy wraps three objects: the device, the context and the swap chain, each a Wrapped class in src/d3d11_proxy.
352 C++23 implementation files across the DX12 translation layer, Creation Engine runtime and test harnesses.
328 C++23 header files defining ABI static assertions, lock-free job queues, meshlets and live control registries.
include/raw_mod_sdk_abi.h and sdk/raw_mod_sdk.bld expose sandboxed BuildLang FFI and hot-reload pass registration.
CMakeLists.txt sets CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD to 23 across d3d11_proxy, raw_engine and every verification target.
vcpkg.json and LICENSE declare MIT licensing across the full source tree.
